title: Discount Heating Leeds | Bathrooms, Heating & Plumbing Supplies
meta_description: Bathrooms, radiators & plumbing supplies at trade prices. Open to the public with expert advice and top brands across Leeds and West Yorkshire.
paragraphs: Trusted stockists of luxury bathroom products and high-quality heating solutions for plumbers, heating engineers, fitters, installers and developers.

Our professional Leeds-based team supports property professionals and tradespeople across Yorkshire with everything needed to create stunning bathrooms and efficient heating solutions at an affordable price. Your customers want the best – and it’s our job to help you deliver the best.

Providing expert advice, design ideas and the optimum choice in high-quality products – all sourced from the UK’s leading bathroom and heating suppliers and manufacturers. We cover your complete bathroom and heating requirements, from shower columns to column radiators, taps to toilets, baths to boilers and everything in between.

Whether you’re a qualified plumber, professional installer, experienced heating engineer, property developer or renovation enthusiast, you’ll find all your bathroom and heating supplies right here under one roof.

Many suppliers don’t sell directly to trades or consumers, but they will sell to us – a trusted plumbing and heating merchant based in Leeds. If you’ve seen it, we can source it – check out our supplier list.

With hundreds of bathroom and heating products on display, our showroom in Leeds is the perfect place to find inspiration or look through our supplier catalogues. If you already know what products you need, chat with our team, and we’ll source them for you. If your order is over £500 and you’re based in West Yorkshire, we’ll bring your supplies directly to your door.
Our trade counter is open Monday to Friday, 7.30am to 4.30pm.
🛠️ Plumbers merchants & bathroom showroom in North Leeds
